hooks.name: Secret Scan Before Commit
hooks.description: Scans staged files for potential secrets (API keys, passwords, tokens) before any git commit. Warns if suspicious patterns are found.

action.command: grep -rn --include='*.js' --include='*.json' --include='*.env' -E '(password|secret|api[_-]?key|token|private[_-]?key)\s*[:=]\s*["\x27][^"\x27]{8,}' . --exclude-dir=node_modules --exclude-dir=.git || echo 'Secret scan passed: no hardcoded secrets found.'
